posts.author: Jordan Bastian
posts.text: Since Seiya Suzuki was put in the No. 2 spot on July 11, the Cubs' production out of the Nos. 1-2 spots included a 143 wRC+ and .887 OPS, entering Monday -- both first in the NL and 3rd overall in MLB in that span. Pete Crow-Armstrong and Suzuki opened tonight's game with back-to-back homers.
posts.jp: 7月11日にスズキ・セイヤが2番に配置されて以来、カブスの1-2番の生産性は143 wRC+と.887 OPSで、月曜日時点でこの期間NLで1位、MLB全体で3位。クロウ・アームストロングとスズキは今夜の試合を連続本塁打で開いた。

posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Incredible. Pete Crow-Armstrong slugs a walk-off 2-run HR to give the Cubs a 7-5 win against the White Sox. That's his 30th home run of the season and makes him just the 2nd Cub in franchise history with back-to-back 30/30 seasons.

reply_texts.text: First Cub to do it back-to-back. Sammy did it in 93 and 95.
reply_texts.author: thekbexperience.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Leadoff and walkoff hr in same game has to be pretty rare
reply_texts.author: edbt24.bsky.social

reply_texts.text:
"America's pastime"
The sport nobody gets to see.
reply_texts.author: jonathanmlewis.bsky.social

posts.jp: 素晴らしい。ピート・クロウ・アームストロングがサヨナラ2点本塁打を打ち、カブスがホワイトソックスに7-5で勝利。今シーズン30本目の本塁打で、フランチャイズ史上2番目の30-30シーズン連続達成者となった。

posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Pete Crow-Armstrong's performance tonight -- featuring 2 HRs, 2B, 1B, BB, K, SB and 3 RBIs -- added 0.5 fWAR to his season total, which is wild. 12 qualified MLB hitters have produced an fWAR less than that this season, including Kyle Tucker (0.4).
posts.jp: ピート・クロウ・アームストロングの今夜のパフォーマンス（2本塁打、2塁打、1塁打、四球、三振、盗塁、3打点）は0.5 fWARをシーズン合計に追加した。これはワイルド。12人のML適格打者がこれ以下のfWARを記録している。

posts.text: Today is the one-year anniversary of Vladimir Guerrero Jr.'s last regular season home run at Rogers Centre. He's made 333 plate appearances at home since this swing. #BlueJays

posts.author: Jordan Bastian
posts.text: From @slangsonsports.bsky.social ⤵️ Pete Crow-Armstrong is the fifth player in the last 50 years with a leadoff and walk-off home run in the same game, joining: 8/7/10 Chris Young 7/19/09 Ian Kinsler 6/15/03 Reed Johnson 6/25/00 Darin Erstad
posts.jp: ピート・クロウ・アームストロングは過去50年で先頭打者本塁打とサヨナラ本塁打を同一試合で打った5番目の選手。クリス・ヤング、イアン・キンスラー、リード・ジョンソン、ダリン・アーステッドらと並ぶ。
